node.title: Re: DBI search for forward slash
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Simple DBI search

You say "search" but are using [https://www.w3schools.com/sql/sql_where.asp|WHERE] for exact matches. Are you sure you don't mean [https://www.w3schools.com/sql/sql_like.asp|LIKE]?

Otherwise, you'll have to provide an [id://1177642|SSCCE] that reproduces this behavior, because I don't really see anything wrong with the code snippet you've shown, and you haven't shown any sample data.
